title: Bio-Dynamic monitoring, diagnosis and follow-up of Abdominal Aortic Aneurysms using optical imaging techniques
summary: Untersuchung des Einsatzes berührungsloser (optischer) Messtechniken für die Diagnostik und Überwachung des abdominellen Aortenaneurysmas vor und nach endovaskulären Eingriffen.
conditions: Abdominal aortic aneurysm, without mention of rupture

interventions.name: Study participants with abdominal aortic aneurysm will be examined once before and after intervention using the specially developed BioScanRack, a non-contact technique that measures the puslative movements of the abdomen.
Study participants without aortic pathologies are examined once using a non-contact technique that measures the puslative movements of the abdomen.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-Capable of giving consent
-Patients with abdominal aortic aneurysm (Dmax men ≥ 5,5 cm, Dmax women ≥ 5,0 cm)
-Patients without aortic pathologies
-BMI < 35
Exclusion criteria:
- Patients with acute symptomatic BAA
- Patients with condition after stenting or open interventions in the area of the iliac arteries and thoracic aorta
- Patients with concomitant aneurysms of the iliac arteries 
- Patients for whom written information is not possible
- Vulnerable population
